title: TracAssets
subtitle: Enterprise Low-Code & Real-Time Asset Management Platform
scopeNote: Full-stack frontend and backend feature ownership across physical/digital asset registration, BLE/GPS telemetry, licence tracking, maintenance workflows, six-step transfers, and background automation jobs.
summary: Enterprise low-code and asset management platform governing end-to-end physical and digital asset operations, including live BLE indoor floor-map positioning, RFID support, GPS fleet tracking with Google Maps geofencing alerts, software license management, AMC/reactive maintenance, six-step custody transfers, barcode audits, and SLA/depreciation background jobs.
businessProblem: Enterprises managing thousands of physical hardware devices, fleet vehicles, and software subscriptions struggle with fragmented tracking spreadsheets, unmonitored licence expirations, unverified inter-facility asset transfers, and delayed maintenance cycles.
contributions: Built screens and backend logic to register physical hardware (laptops, equipment) and render live indoor floor-map locations using Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) beacons and RFID support.

Integrated GPS and vehicle telematics with Google Maps to track live transit routes and configure virtual geofence boundaries that trigger instant alerts on unauthorized entry, exit, or route deviation.
Implemented software license management features to track software purchases, allocate license seats to employees or machines, and trigger automated renewal reminders before subscriptions expire.
Developed preventive (AMC) and reactive breakdown maintenance scheduling modules, including technician task assignments and visit inspection checklists.

Engineered a complete six-step asset transfer process: transfer request, manager approval, gate pass dispatch, in-transit asset locking, receiving inspection with damage photo capture, and digital sign-off with automatic custody updates.
Implemented physical barcode audit workflows and automated background jobs for SLA monitoring, license renewal notifications, and asset depreciation calculations.
keyFeatures: Live BLE indoor floor-map positioning & RFID tag tracking
GPS fleet route tracking & Google Maps geofencing deviation alerts
Software license seat allocation & automated expiry notifications
AMC preventive servicing & reactive repair technician workflows
Six-stage gated asset transfer lifecycle with digital sign-off
Automated SLA, renewal, and depreciation background jobs
challenges: Coordinating high-frequency MQTT/WebSocket telemetry updates from BLE beacons and GPS trackers without overwhelming browser rendering on indoor floor maps.
Enforcing strict state-machine integrity across the six-step transfer lifecycle so in-transit assets cannot be modified or reassigned prior to receiving inspection and digital sign-off.
Designing deterministic background job schedules for depreciation, SLA breach detection, and multi-tier license renewal notifications.
verifiedImpact: Unified physical hardware, fleet telematics, and digital software license lifecycles into a single enterprise platform at Techcedence.
Established auditable six-stage custody handoffs with inspection evidence and automated custody updates.

architectureNotes.label: Real-Time Telemetry Pipeline
architectureNotes.description: BLE beacon and GPS telemetry events are ingested via MQTT and pushed to connected Angular clients over WebSockets for live indoor map and Google Maps updates.

architectureNotes.label: Relational Persistence & ORM
architectureNotes.description: PostgreSQL managed through Prisma ORM enforces relational constraints across asset registries, license entitlements, maintenance tickets, and transfer custody logs.

architectureNotes.label: Proposed Telemetry Throttling & Job Queue Topology
architectureNotes.description: Illustrative architecture note: Debounced client-side viewport state updates combined with scheduled worker queues isolate heavy depreciation and SLA calculations from interactive API traffic.
